committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2013-12-02
committee_action.remarks: 1st TWG Meeting
committee_action.meethigh: It was suggested that the nomenclature of the entire proposed bill should be reviewed so that the terms "sexual orientation and gender identity" or SOGI be used consistently. RRB was tasked to look for crimes with similar penalties. CSC will proposed a revised draft of the provision on penalties, Sec6.There are many comments of Section 3 of the Bill.

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2014-01-22
committee_action.remarks: Technical Working Group Meeting
committee_action.meethigh: *The body agreed to use the term "sexual orientation & gender identity" *As suggested by PCW, the body agreed to adopt the definition of "Sexual orientation" and "gender identity" as stated in the Yogyakarta Principles, Section 3(b) of the consolidated bill *In the definition of discrimination in Section 3 (a), the body agreed to include the word "perceived" & submit the decision of its inclusion or exclusion for advertisement of the mother committee *The body noted the opinion submitted by the Reference and Research Bureau (RRB). With regard to the penalty imposed, Ms. Sanga will discuss the matter with RRB again. *The Committee will follow-up the assignment of the CSC with regards to Section 4 (a) and 4 (b) *The Office of Rep. Bag-a0 (one of the authors) proposed a new wording for Section 4 (c).The same was adopted by the body *The group adopted the suggestion of Rep. Aragones (one of the authors)to delete Section 4(k) and retain Section 7 *The group noted the proposal of the Library Foundation (TLF) Share to revise Section 4 (h) but the group agreed to keep the provision as it is currently written & reject the proposal and *On Section 4 (i), on line 67 after the word "rights" delete the comma (,) and the whole phrase "such as the Philippine National Police and the Armed Forces of the Philippines
